example.description:
Whether to generate simplified, example-style data rather than the full possible range of values.
For example this will produce a simple value like "17" for an `int` rather than a uniform random number in
[-2⁶³..2⁶³).

This is only relevant for untrained models, such as {@link DataGenObj} and {@link DataGenPrimitive}.

seed.description:
Initial seed value for randomization. Note that generators with same seed are required to produce exact same
sequence of values. This value is mutated as methods are called on it; see #next and #array.

size.description: Range of the size of the generated collection.

key.description: Custom specs for keys of the generated collection.

elem.description: Custom specs for elements of the generated collection.

title:
Spec for generating a stream. See {@link Data.generate} & {@link Data.profile}.

Because values are generated on demand, careful management of the seed is necessary to ensure reproducibility of
values from the same seed if calls are intermixed with calls to other sources of randomness.
name: DataGenStream
